items.title: Utah's 2% adult-content excise tax takes effect October 1
items.summary: Utah SB73 imposes a 2% excise tax on revenue from adult digital images, video or audio sold to Utah users, on top of the state's existing age-verification duties, with civil penalties for noncompliance.
items.sowhat: If Nancy sells or licenses any explicit digital content, not just physical toys, to Utah customers, confirm tax registration with finance before October 1.

items.title: Ofcom opens formal investigation into Pornhub's age-assurance system
items.summary: Ofcom launched an Online Safety Act investigation into Aylo (Pornhub's owner) over whether its Apple-device-based age check, rolled out in May 2026, is 'highly effective' at blocking minors; penalties can reach £18m or 10% of global turnover.
items.sowhat: UK regulators are now scrutinizing device-signal shortcuts, not just document checks, so audit whatever age-assurance method gates any UK-facing adult content or storefront.

items.title: Louisiana age-verification law reshapes live video chat services
items.summary: New reporting details how Louisiana's age-verification statute is forcing changes to live video chat and streaming services that operate with or near adult content in the state.
items.sowhat: If Nancy ever runs livestream shopping or creator live-chat features, confirm Louisiana-specific age-gating before targeting that state.

items.title: Womanizer launches Snap and the Liberty 2 Leopard Edition, fresh off IFA Berlin
items.summary: Womanizer's smallest-ever Pleasure Air toy, the Snap, launched in Europe alongside the Liberty 2 Leopard Edition's September 22 North American debut, following the brand's presence at IFA Berlin (Sept 4-8), one of the largest mainstream consumer electronics fairs, where it ran a 'Why Pleasure is the ultimate Beauty Tech' Creator Stage talk.
items.sowhat: Compact, travel-ready design plus mainstream tech-show placement is how the category leader is normalizing pleasure products; borrow the portability and 'beauty tech' framing for Nancy's own content.

items.title: Satisfyer expands to 6,700+ CVS stores, adds a menstrual cup
items.summary: Satisfyer grew its US retail footprint to more than 6,700 CVS locations nationwide and added the 'Feel Confident' menstrual cup to its assortment.
items.sowhat: Mass-drugstore retail keeps normalizing the category; watch for CVS-tagged hauls and UGC worth engaging with, and use retail proof points the way Satisfyer and plusOne do.

items.title: EU pushes pilot countries to speed up its age-verification app
items.summary: The European Commission is urging France, Denmark, Greece, Italy, Spain, Cyprus and Ireland to accelerate rollout of its free, anonymous age-verification app, targeting EU-wide availability by the end of 2026.
items.sowhat: Plan for app-based age gates to become a real distribution factor in these pilot countries before year-end, and budget EU social strategy country by country.

items.title: Ofcom has issued £7m+ in Online Safety Act fines, mostly unpaid
items.summary: Ofcom has fined 11 providers more than £7 million under the Online Safety Act, most of them porn sites, but its enforcement director admits the majority of the fines haven't been paid. The regulator has 40 open investigations covering more than 100 services, including TikTok and X.
items.sowhat: Enforcement is aimed at porn, not wellness retail, but keep explicit imagery off UK-facing pages so the site isn't classed as a pornographic service.

items.title: UK Lords committee presses Ofcom on Online Safety Act enforcement
items.summary: The House of Lords Communications and Digital Committee held an oral evidence session with Ofcom on whether Online Safety Act enforcement is working; a follow-up session is set for October 1, 2026.
items.sowhat: Expect UK enforcement to intensify further into Q4, so build age-assurance and geo-compliance margin into UK content plans now rather than reacting to a fine.

items.title: Maude launches Vibe Mini, a $32 compact vibrator
items.summary: Maude added Vibe Mini, a $32, 3.35-inch, 5-speed flutter-tip vibrator positioned as a compact travel companion to its original Vibe.
items.sowhat: Direct positioning overlap on compact and travel products; benchmark Maude's price point and minimalist 'just landed' copy tone against Nancy's own portable-product messaging.

items.title: Lovense makes its European trade-show debut at IFA Berlin
items.summary: Lovense showed at IFA Berlin for the first time, after years exhibiting only at CES, presenting 'A Day in the Lovense Ecosystem' and a second-generation Intimate Doll prototype with voice interaction and adaptive movement.
items.sowhat: Tech and AI framing at a mainstream electronics show shows where competitor conversation is heading; useful for careful AI-in-intimacy trend-jacking, but keep the tone light rather than uncanny.

items.title: France's under-15 social account ban takes effect without a mandated verification method
items.summary: France began blocking new social media accounts for under-15s on September 1, 2026, but Parliament stripped the mandated verification method from the final bill, leaving the CNIL to approve whatever age-check tools platforms adopt.
items.sowhat: Expect inconsistent or rougher age-gating UX on French traffic for the next few months, so don't treat French audience-targeting numbers as stable during this transition.

items.title: TikTok's ad policy log shows continued health & wellness tightening
items.summary: TikTok's official ad policy change log shows 2026 rules on health and wellness claims still in force, including bans on before/after imagery outside a narrow medical exception, carried over from May and July updates.
items.sowhat: Keep sexual-wellness ad creative in self-care/wellness-aid framing, avoid any transformation implication, and pre-clear via TikTok's allowlisting process rather than assuming previously approved creative still qualifies.

items.title: TikTok branded content still bans sex toys and lube
items.summary: TikTok's Branded Content Policy still lists 'adult and sexual products' as prohibited, naming sex toys, lubricants and fetish costumes, while some contraceptives and medications are allowed. The policy page is undated; it was checked in September 2026, so the 1st of the month is used here.
items.sowhat: Keep TikTok creator deals product-free or education-led (anatomy, communication, myth-busting), and don't tag toys in paid partnerships.

items.title: LELO report predicts an 'analogue counter-movement' in intimacy
items.summary: LELO's 2026 Futurist Report, written with Tracey Follows, finds 60% of people have used AI in their intimate lives, and 18% of Americans have passed off AI-written messages as their own. It predicts a move toward phone-free bedrooms and 'protected human presence'.
items.sowhat: Build a phone-free / offline intimacy content series, which makes a strong counterpoint to AI companion discourse.

items.title: Lovehoney's US 'Sex Map' turns sales data into shareable stats
items.summary: Lovehoney published an interactive map from 12 months of sales, naming Vermont the 'sexiest state', Boston the top city and Arlington, VA the 'kinkiest'. Fun stats such as dildo purchases stretching past 120 Statues of Liberty drove press coverage.
items.sowhat: Mine your own anonymized sales data for local, shareable stat posts, which fit X and local-pride formats well.

items.title: Satisfyer sails a Pro 2-shaped boat at WorldPride Amsterdam
items.summary: Satisfyer sponsored a boat modelled on its Satisfyer Pro 2 in the WorldPride Amsterdam Canal Parade on August 1, 2026. It carried the message that everyone deserves pleasure 'without shame, without limits, and without exclusion'.
items.sowhat: Plan physical, photogenic activations tied to cultural moments, which travel well on IG and TikTok without showing product explicitly.

items.title: Lovehoney opens Q4 early with five 2026 advent calendars
items.summary: Lovehoney launched five advent calendars ($129-$369) in August, featuring Womanizer and We-Vibe toys, and positioned them as selling out fast. The exact launch day is unconfirmed, so the 1st of the month is used here.
items.sowhat: Advent and gifting content is already live at competitors, so start your holiday gift-guide content in October, not November.

items.title: plusOne is now in 25,000+ US doors after its Ulta Beauty launch
items.summary: plusOne (Beacon Wellness Brands) launched in 1,300+ Ulta Beauty stores in July and by September had grown to more than 25,000 US doors including Walmart, Target, CVS, Walgreens, Meijer and Amazon; it also convened a 2026 Wellness Collective expert panel on sex ed, gynecology and pelvic health.
items.sowhat: Mass beauty and drugstore retail is now a core distribution channel for the category, so lean into beauty-shelf visuals (vanity shelfies, GRWM) and use retail availability as proof in social posts.
